svg.data-spec:
title: funcd artifacts kind: flow
[Build] gray right code: Code | a file or a bundle @blue contract: Contract file | runtime, input, output @blue [/] push: funcdctl push | prints ref@digest @purple target: OCI target | a registry or a layout @db @coral fn: Function | spec.image @blue rev: Revision | pins the digest @green pull: funcd pulls | by digest, verified @green cache: Artifact cache | per digest and platform @db @coral worker: Worker | runs the code @blue
code > push contract > push push > target fn > rev rev > pull target > pull pull > cache cache > worker
